conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Rohit Sharma. Mera savings account ka minimum balance charge kyun laga?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Rohit ji, main check karta hoon. Kya aap apna account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapka account balance last month minimum requirement se kam tha. Isliye ₹500 ka charge laga. Kya main ise waive karne ki request daal doon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Theek hai, main request daal deta hoon. 3-5 din mein charge reverse ho jayega. Koi aur madad?
